Our warranty covers manufacturer defects in materials or workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item and, for warmers, when you bought it:
Warmers bought before March 20, 2026: one year from purchase.
Warmers bought on or after March 20, 2026: six months from purchase. You can qualify for a free two-year limited warranty by registering the warmer within 60 days of purchase.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: six months from purchase.
